events.title: Dasara Inauguration & Chamundeshwari Pooja
events.description: Traditional rituals marking the beginning of the 2026 celebrations atop Chamundi Hill.

events.title: Jamboo Savari (Grand Elephant Procession)
events.description: The spectacular grand finale where Goddess Chamundeshwari is carried in the 750kg Golden Howdah.

events.title: Panjina Kavayatthu (Torchlight Parade)
events.description: Breathtaking military and police displays, stunts, and cultural performances closing the festival.

events.title: Aahara Mela (Food Festival)
events.description: Taste authentic Karnataka cuisine, tribal delicacies, and pan-Indian street food.

events.title: Dasara CM Cup - Nada Kusti
events.description: Traditional Mysore wrestling drawing pehlwans from across the state.
events.source: Department of Youth Empowerment and Sports

places.name: Amba Vilas Palace (Mysuru Palace)
places.description: The historical center of Dasara, illuminated with 100,000 bulbs every evening.

places.name: Chamundi Hill & Temple
places.description: Sacred hill overlooking the city, home to the patron deity Goddess Chamundeshwari.

places.name: Karanji Lake
places.description: A serene nature park featuring a walk-through aviary and butterfly park.

places.name: Devaraja Market
places.description: Vibrant century-old market famous for Mysore pak, silk, spices, and festival flowers.
